text: AGG-031 BGP to the east peer is flapping since the 9.4.2 upgrade last night. Same as AGG-014 in May?
No config bundle went to AGG-031, only the firmware. The timers are untouched. CRC errors are climbing on the east link though.
Confirmed, CRC errors are high on the east link port, about 2100 in the last hour.
Replaced the optic on the east link. The session is steady now.
